example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা ডেঁপো ছেলে, এখনও পুরোপুরি বড় হয়নি।
এই গাছের ফল ডেঁপো হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a runt, not fully grown yet.
The fruit on this tree has turned premature.
note: Often used to describe physical underdevelopment in children or plants, rooted in rural Bengali observations of growth.
